description: A slow-moving, translucent mass of semi-solid goo that digests anything it comes in contact with. It silently moves through dungeons or dark caves, consuming anything organic. The Gelatinous Blob is mindless, but persistent, making it a dangerous foe for adventurers.
condition_immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Prone

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The Gelatinous Blob can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Transparent
traits.description: Even when the blob is in plain sight, it takes a successful Wisdom (Perception) check to spot a Gelatinous Blob that has neither moved nor attacked.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6+4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.description: The blob moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Large or smaller creatures' spaces. Whenever the blob enters a creature's space, the creature must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw.
